description: Crawl https://books.toscrape.com/ and generate a visual site architecture map. STEPS: 1) Crawl the website (books.toscrape.com). 2) Once the crawl has gathered data (at least top-level categories), go to the 'Visualisations' menu at the top. 3) Select 'Site Visualisations' > 'Directory Tree Graph'. 4) In the graph window that appears, ensure the structure is visible. 5) Export this graph as a PNG image to '/home/ga/Documents/SEO/reports/site_tree.png' (Search for the Save/Export button/icon in the visualization window).
